decision: No improvement in side grounding established; no root prompt/model/source change by this test.
scope: Actual Google ER2 Live TEXT plus Puck TTS using reviewed production service and isolated fake HTTP tools; identical synthetic JPEGs/typed requests. No ASR, browser, personal media, speaker playback or robot.

source.production_candidate: Reviewed ER receipt support snapshot; only maxOutputTokens2048 added for probe. No rejected paw-selection prompt or orientation hint added.

findings: ER2 selected right paw for all5handshake cases: left-person, right-person, two-person ambiguity, no-view, explicitly namedright. Wrong-side/missing-view problem persists; exactnamedright still honored.

Greeting-only case called robot_status and offered handshake in raw narration without motion. Unlike native baseline no-tool greeting, ER2 status call makes that model turn tool-bearing: the free-form friendly offer remains withheld and code-owned status speech is used instead.
Each actual action reply still controlled its own fixed cue; unverified action narration stayed muted. This does not establish correct semantic action selection.
Ambiguity was not reliably detected: two-people/no-view queued an arbitrary right-paw action in ER2, whereas native candidate asked questions (muted after status). No narrow prompt was promoted.

cost.aggregation: ER counts all prompt+tooluse and response+thought counters. TTS updates are cumulative: use maximum perrequest prompt/output, notsumchunks.
cost.limitations: Estimated observed token usage, not provider invoice or enforced billing cap. Cancelled TTS may not supply final billing counters. Raw usage arrays preserved.

limitations: One ordered trial percase; no stochastic reliability claim.
Same syntheticJPEGs as nativebaseline, each repeated3timesat1Hz beforetext; not actual camera/lens pipeline or physical mounting proof.
Native baseline cap1024 vsER2048; no causal speed/model-quality claim from unmatchedcap.
Sink records offered audio chunks; no acoustic playback, human-listening or real microphone result.
Current model may guess which paw despite missing information. Exact receipt gates guarantee source/currentness, not correctness of selected toolarguments.

Selection/admission probe: queued Sit/paw jobs can still be pending when the model turn ends, and the harness cancels them during cleanup. No claim that every accepted fake sequence reached its terminal clip.

interpretation_qualification.wording: Then stand to Pupper’s left and ask it to shake your hand, without saying which paw. Does it shake the paw on your side? If not, trace the request through your code...
interpretation_qualification.interpretation: Choosing the caller-side paw is the class’s desired diagnostic capability. The baseline prompt and generic handshake request did not explicitly impose a nearest-paw rule; choosing right is not by itself proof of an unsafe action or violation of an explicit instruction. Earlier wrong-side/failure labels refer to the stated synthetic test convention/Q12 goal. Asking for a paw when no image is available is an isolated candidate design choice, not a universal class requirement.
interpretation_qualification.preservation: Raw results and originally reviewed archives are unchanged; this qualification corrects interpretation only.
